2. Recover any lost or destroyed records. If a record cannot be recovered, document the type of data it contains and why it is difficult to recover.
5. Gather the cause of the accident using the accident record form.
6. Collect all reports (formal and informal) related to the failed inspection.
7. Include all post-inspection correspondence.
8. Create a project database using the audit reports and inspection reports.
9. Document any data requests.
10. Record the outcome of the safety audit.
